limits: Native completion, saved-checker pass and full success remain distinct; failed durations are included.
Recorded native patch rejection counts come from original runner rejection lists, including stderr-derived attempts. Sparse JSONL item events do not prove no tool call or attempt occurred.
Derived helper aliases are restored to native identities; translated event logs alone do not establish which model-facing helper was selected.
Command counts are observations only. Prints, syntax, missing source hashes and failed whole commands do not prove all assertions executed or final saved code was verified.
Strict single-terminal and literal duration observations are separate from the unchanged official endpoint; no retrospective scoring change.
Recorded termination labels are preserved without guessing an unrecorded timeout or transport exception subtype. Checker exit2 can be an implementation exception, not necessarily infrastructure.
Three repetitions per known case/profile are descriptive; no historical pooling, general causal gain, held-out or ordinary90-second coding qualification.
This exporter reads completed receipts only and executes no model, native client, generated command or checker.
